findings.issue: All 6 D4 CHECKPOINTs in docstring (L32-37) marked [ ] with zero code verification. No trading-day/sector-date/sentiment/percentage/consistency/section checks.

findings.issue: Bare except Exception: pass in load_history (L379). Silently swallows JSON/file errors on corrupt history. No warning printed.

findings.issue: D9 anti-pattern #2 violated: bias analysis uses placeholder values '待分析'/'待定' instead of tracing root cause (Feynman three-layer).

findings.issue: Hardcoded relative path for memory/ on L997: os.path.join(dirname, ../.., memory). Should use p() utility.

findings.issue: D4 CP2 declared as '检查mtime或写入内容' but update_knowledge writes with no verification. Assumes success.

findings.issue: Bare except Exception: pass in fetch_sector_rotation (L286) violates own D9 #6. Silently swallows all API errors. No diagnostic.
